/* ==========================================================================
   Design tokens v2 (Release 2.0, US-201). Source: docs/design/tokens-v2.css.
   - Night is the default (:root). Day overrides live under [data-theme="day"].
   - v1 names (--bg, --text2, --amber, ...) remain as aliases at the bottom.
   - Every text/background pair meets WCAG 2.1 AA (verified by IT-045).
   - Brand accents (night): amber #f59e0b, cyan #22d3ee, green #34d399,
     rose #fb7185, violet #a78bfa are unchanged from v1.1.
   - Motion tokens live in motion.css.
   ========================================================================== */

:root {
  /* ---------- Color: surfaces (night) ---------- */
  --color-bg:            #060c18;   /* page */
  --color-bg-raised:     #090f1e;   /* alternate band (was --bg2) */
  --color-surface:       #0d1626;   /* solid card / band (was --surf) */
  --color-surface-2:     #111d30;   /* nested surface (was --surf2) */
  --color-glass:         rgba(13, 22, 38, 0.55);
  --color-glass-strong:  rgba(13, 22, 38, 0.78);  /* nav, menus: text must stay legible over orbs */
  --color-glass-edge:    rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.10);
  --color-glass-shine:   rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.06);

  /* ---------- Color: text (night) ---------- */
  --color-text:          #e2e8f0;   /* 15.87:1 on bg */
  --color-text-2:        #94a3b8;   /*  7.63:1 on bg */
  --color-text-3:        #8291a7;   /*  6.11:1 on bg, 5.28:1 on surface-2 — replaces #475569 for meta text */
  --color-text-disabled: #475569;   /*  2.58:1 — disabled state ONLY (WCAG exempt) */

  /* ---------- Color: brand accent (night) ---------- */
  --color-accent:        #f59e0b;   /* amber — 9.11:1 on bg */
  --color-accent-hi:     #fbbf24;
  --color-accent-text:   #f59e0b;   /* accent used as small text */
  --color-on-accent:     #06080f;   /* 9.32:1 on #f59e0b, 11.99:1 on #fbbf24 */
  --color-accent-tint:   rgba(245, 158, 11, 0.12);
  --color-accent-edge:   rgba(245, 158, 11, 0.35);

  /* ---------- Color: telemetry signals (night) ----------
     Used for per-project / per-category colouring. Always reference these
     tokens, never hard-coded hex, so the day theme can darken them. */
  --sig-amber:  #f59e0b;  /* 6.50:1 on its own 12% tint over surface-2 */
  --sig-cyan:   #22d3ee;  /* 7.30:1 */
  --sig-green:  #34d399;  /* 6.95:1 */
  --sig-violet: #a78bfa;  /* 5.16:1 */
  --sig-rose:   #fb7185;  /* 5.33:1 */
  --sig-sky:    #38bdf8;  /* 6.32:1 */
  --sig-tint-alpha: 0.12;

  /* ---------- Color: lines & focus (night) ---------- */
  --color-border:        rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.07);  /* decorative dividers */
  --color-border-2:      rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.13);
  --color-border-control:#56698a;   /* 3.52:1 on bg — outline buttons, chips that are controls (WCAG 1.4.11) */
  --color-focus:         #f59e0b;   /* 9.11:1 on bg */
  --color-focus-halo:    rgba(245, 158, 11, 0.28);
  --color-success:       #34d399;   /* "open to opportunities" status */

  /* ---------- Typography ---------- */
  --font-mono: 'Share Tech Mono', ui-monospace, 'SFMono-Regular', Menlo, Consolas, monospace;
  --font-sans: 'Barlow', system-ui, -apple-system, 'Segoe UI', Roboto, Arial, sans-serif;
  --font-disp: 'Barlow Condensed', 'Arial Narrow', 'Roboto Condensed', system-ui, sans-serif;

  /* Type scale (fluid, 360 → 1440 px). Floor for any readable text: 12px. */
  --fs-display: clamp(2.5rem, 1.6rem + 4.2vw, 4.5rem);    /* 40 → 72  hero name */
  --fs-h2:      clamp(2rem, 1.5rem + 2.2vw, 3.25rem);     /* 32 → 52  section title */
  --fs-h3:      clamp(1.25rem, 1.1rem + 0.6vw, 1.5rem);   /* 20 → 24  card title */
  --fs-h4:      1.125rem;                                 /* 18       sub-title */
  --fs-lead:    clamp(1.0625rem, 1rem + 0.3vw, 1.1875rem);/* 17 → 19  hero value line */
  --fs-body:    1rem;                                     /* 16       paragraphs (was 13–15) */
  --fs-body-sm: 0.9375rem;                                /* 15       card body */
  --fs-ui:      0.8125rem;                                /* 13       buttons, nav, chips (mono) */
  --fs-meta:    0.75rem;                                  /* 12       labels, periods, tags (mono) — minimum */
  --lh-tight: 1.05;  --lh-snug: 1.3;  --lh-body: 1.65;
  --tracking-label: 0.18em;   /* mono uppercase labels (was up to 0.3em) */
  --tracking-ui:    0.06em;
  --measure: 68ch;            /* max line length for body copy */

  /* ---------- Spacing (4 px base) ---------- */
  --space-1: 4px;  --space-2: 8px;  --space-3: 12px; --space-4: 16px;
  --space-5: 20px; --space-6: 24px; --space-8: 32px; --space-10: 40px;
  --space-12: 48px; --space-16: 64px; --space-20: 80px; --space-24: 96px;
  --gutter: clamp(16px, 4vw, 44px);           /* page side padding */
  --section-y: clamp(64px, 8vw, 96px);        /* section vertical padding */
  --container: 1160px;

  /* ---------- Radii ---------- */
  --radius-xs: 4px;    /* tags, chips (was 2–3px) */
  --radius-sm: 8px;    /* buttons, skill chips, contact items */
  --radius-md: 14px;   /* cards */
  --radius-lg: 20px;   /* gauge / instrument panel */
  --radius-pill: 999px;

  /* ---------- Elevation / glass ---------- */
  --blur-glass: 24px;
  --blur-glass-strong: 28px;
  --elev-0: none;
  --elev-1: 0 2px 12px rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.12), inset 0 1px 0 var(--color-glass-shine);
  --elev-2: 0 4px 24px rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.16), inset 0 1px 0 var(--color-glass-shine);
  --elev-3: 0 16px 48px rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.22), inset 0 1px 0 var(--color-glass-shine);
  --elev-glow: 0 0 60px rgba(245, 158, 11, 0.08);

  /* ---------- Z-index scale ---------- */
  --z-backdrop: 0;     /* grid, orbs, particles */
  --z-content: 1;
  --z-raised: 2;       /* hero columns, card internals */
  --z-sticky: 200;     /* in-section sticky bars (skills filter) */
  --z-menu: 299;       /* mobile menu sheet */
  --z-nav: 300;
  --z-skip: 400;       /* skip link (above nav) */
  --z-toast: 500;      /* "email copied" toast */
  --z-cursor: 9998;    /* decorative cursor glow, pointer-events:none */

  /* ---------- Sizing ---------- */
  --nav-h: 64px;
  --nav-h-compact: 54px;
  --target-min: 44px;  /* touch target for primary controls */
}

  --color-accent-text:   #a14a06;   /* small amber text: 5.72:1 on bg, 4.98:1 on its tint (was #b45309 4.79 / 4.18) */

  --color-accent-edge:   #b45309;   /* 1px edge on amber fills: 4.79:1 vs bg (fill alone is 2.05:1) */

  --sig-amber:  #a14a06;  /* 4.98:1 on own 10% tint */
  --sig-cyan:   #0369a1;  /* 4.91:1 */

  --color-focus-halo:    rgba(180, 83, 9, 0.25);
  --color-success:       #047857;

  --elev-1: 0 2px 10px rgba(60, 40, 10, 0.06), inset 0 1px 0 var(--color-glass-shine);
  --elev-2: 0 4px 20px rgba(60, 40, 10, 0.08), inset 0 1px 0 var(--color-glass-shine);

/* ---------- v1 aliases (keep until all rules are migrated) ---------- */
:root, [data-theme="day"] {
  --bg: var(--color-bg);           --bg2: var(--color-bg-raised);
  --surf: var(--color-surface);    --surf2: var(--color-surface-2);
  --bdr: var(--color-border);      --bdr2: var(--color-border-2);
  --text: var(--color-text);       --text2: var(--color-text-2);
  --muted: var(--color-text-3);    /* v2 intentionally lifts every --muted usage to AA */
  --amber: var(--color-accent-text);
  --cyan: var(--sig-cyan);  --green: var(--sig-green);  --rose: var(--sig-rose);  --violet: var(--sig-violet);
  --mono: var(--font-mono); --sans: var(--font-sans);   --disp: var(--font-disp);
  --glass-bg: var(--color-glass); --glass-bdr: var(--color-glass-edge); --glass-shine: var(--color-glass-shine);
}

/* ==========================================================================
   Motion tokens (US-202). Values from docs/design/motion-prototypes/*.
   Under prefers-reduced-motion every duration resolves to 0.01ms
   (FR-MOTION-007). Raw ms values are allowed only in this file and tokens.css.
   ========================================================================== */
:root {
  --dur-instant: 80ms;
  --dur-fast: 140ms;
  --dur-base: 220ms;
  --dur-slow: 360ms;
  --dur-deliberate: 600ms;
  --dur-theme: 360ms;
  --dur-intro-max: 1200ms;

  --ease-standard: cubic-bezier(0.2, 0, 0, 1);
  --ease-decel: cubic-bezier(0.05, 0.7, 0.1, 1);
  --ease-accel: cubic-bezier(0.3, 0, 0.8, 0.15);
  --ease-decelerate: var(--ease-decel);
  --ease-accelerate: var(--ease-accel);
  --ease-emphasized: cubic-bezier(0.83, 0, 0.17, 1);
  --ease-telltale: cubic-bezier(0.4, 0, 1, 1);
}

@media (prefers-reduced-motion: reduce) {
  :root {
    --dur-instant: 0.01ms;
    --dur-fast: 0.01ms;
    --dur-base: 0.01ms;
    --dur-slow: 0.01ms;
    --dur-deliberate: 0.01ms;
    --dur-theme: 0.01ms;
    --dur-intro-max: 0.01ms;
  }
}

/* Documented reduced-motion exemptions: none. Running CSS animations are
   forced to a single 0.01ms iteration by the rule in sections.css. */

/* ── SMOOTH THEME TRANSITIONS ── */
html { transition: background-color var(--dur-theme) var(--ease-standard), color var(--dur-theme) var(--ease-standard); }
body { transition: background var(--dur-theme) var(--ease-standard), color var(--dur-theme) var(--ease-standard); }
.nav, .gauge-widget, .stat-card, .project-card, .skill-group,
.cert-card, .edu-card, .profile-info-panel, .resume-preview,
.exp-item, .badge, .btn, footer {
  transition:
    background var(--dur-theme) var(--ease-standard),
    background-color var(--dur-theme) var(--ease-standard),
    border-color var(--dur-theme) var(--ease-standard),
    color var(--dur-theme) var(--ease-standard),
    box-shadow var(--dur-theme) var(--ease-standard);
}

*, *::before, *::after { box-sizing: border-box; margin: 0; padding: 0; }
html { scroll-behavior: smooth; font-size: 16px; }
body {
  background: var(--bg); color: var(--text);
  font-family: var(--sans); font-weight: 300; line-height: 1.7;
  overflow-x: hidden;
}
a { color: inherit; text-decoration: none; }
::selection { background: var(--color-accent-edge); color: var(--color-text); }

}

/* ── KEYFRAMES ── */
@keyframes fadeUp   { from { opacity:0; transform:translateY(28px); } to { opacity:1; transform:translateY(0); } }
@keyframes fadeIn   { from { opacity:0; } to { opacity:1; } }
@keyframes slideIn  { from { opacity:0; transform:translateX(-20px); } to { opacity:1; transform:translateX(0); } }
@keyframes rspin    { to { transform: translate(-50%,-50%) rotate(360deg); } }
@keyframes rspinRev { to { transform: translate(-50%,-50%) rotate(-360deg); } }
@keyframes pulse    { 0%,100% { box-shadow: 0 0 0 0 rgba(52,211,153,0.5); } 50% { box-shadow: 0 0 0 6px rgba(52,211,153,0); } }
@keyframes scanline { 0% { top: 0%; opacity: 0.8; } 100% { top: 100%; opacity: 0; } }
@keyframes blink    { 0%,100% { opacity:1; } 50% { opacity:0; } }
@keyframes float    { 0%,100% { transform:translateY(0px); } 50% { transform:translateY(-10px); } }
@keyframes shimmer  { 0% { background-position: -200% center; } 100% { background-position: 200% center; } }
@keyframes particleFade {
  0%   { transform: translateY(0) translateX(0) scale(1); opacity: 0.8; }
  100% { transform: translateY(-120px) translateX(var(--dx)) scale(0); opacity: 0; }
}
@keyframes glow     { 0%,100% { filter: drop-shadow(0 0 4px rgba(245,158,11,0.4)); } 50% { filter: drop-shadow(0 0 12px rgba(245,158,11,0.8)); } }
@keyframes borderTrace {
  0%   { clip-path: inset(0 100% 0 0); }
  100% { clip-path: inset(0 0 0 0); }
}
@keyframes countUp { from { opacity:0; transform:scale(0.7); } to { opacity:1; transform:scale(1); } }
@keyframes orbFloat1 { 0%,100% { transform:translate(0,0) scale(1); } 33% { transform:translate(40px,-30px) scale(1.1); } 66% { transform:translate(-25px,35px) scale(0.92); } }
@keyframes orbFloat2 { 0%,100% { transform:translate(0,0) scale(1); } 50% { transform:translate(-40px,-50px) scale(1.15); } }
@keyframes orbFloat3 { 0%,100% { transform:translate(0,0) scale(1); } 40% { transform:translate(30px,40px) scale(0.88); } 80% { transform:translate(-15px,-25px) scale(1.08); } }
@keyframes orbFloat4 { 0%,100% { transform:translate(0,0) scale(1); } 60% { transform:translate(20px,-30px) scale(1.05); } }
@keyframes cursorPulse { 0%,100% { opacity:0.6; transform:translate(-50%,-50%) scale(1); } 50% { opacity:0.3; transform:translate(-50%,-50%) scale(1.2); } }
@keyframes sunriseFade { from { opacity:0; transform:translateY(8px); } to { opacity:1; transform:translateY(0); } }

:focus-visible,
a:focus-visible,
button:focus-visible,

  outline: 2px solid var(--color-focus);
  outline-offset: 2px;
  box-shadow: 0 0 0 5px var(--color-focus-halo);
}
/* Mouse/touch focus gets no ring; keyboard focus is covered by :focus-visible above. */
:focus:not(:focus-visible) {
  outline: none;
}
